notes.supports_cache_reset: No public free_cache in v1.5.3; drains the queue and calls pagetable.reset_page_table(), verified by get_cache_stats().
notes.supports_cuda_graphs: v1.5.3 has no CUDA-graph capture path.
notes.supports_kv_quantization: Available (CacheLayer_quant) but the official configuration runs the default fp16 cache.
notes.supports_prefix_cache: Automatic, page-granular (256-token pages) via a chained content-hash page table; best-effort under eviction.
notes.supports_static_batching: Real batched decode: all sequences are enqueued before any decode step and advance in lockstep, one token per iterate().
